recipe.name: Bread In 20 Minutes Recipe
ingredients: 1/4 cup (60 milliliters) olive oil or melted butter
instructions: Prepare the oven environment by heating to 425F (220C) and coating a baking pan with a light grease to prevent sticking.
In a spacious mixing bowl, thoroughly blend the powdery components – ensuring an even distribution of flour, baking powder, salt, and sugar.
Create a unified mixture by gently incorporating milk and olive oil (or melted butter) into the dry ingredients, stirring minimally to form a cohesive dough without overmixing.
Carefully transfer the dough into the prepared baking pan, using gentle motions to spread it evenly across the surface, creating a uniform thickness.
Position the pan in the preheated oven and bake for 12-15 minutes, monitoring the bread’s transformation to a golden-brown hue and checking doneness with a toothpick test.
Remove from the oven and allow the bread to rest momentarily, then slice into desired portions, serving while still warm for optimal texture and flavor.
